about: Where every column of data.js gets its values. verify/tables.js (the gate) fails on a column of data.js that is not here. Sources: bsdata (BSData wh40k-11e), wahapedia, gw (Games Workshop's documents), newrecruit (the owner's New Recruit PDFs), derived (computed by a verify/ script), hand (written by hand, with the note saying how it is checked), ai-summary (an AI-written one-line summary; carries a fingerprint of the text it was written from, gistOf), ai-reading (the app's reading of a rule's words into numbers and lines, by AI or by verify/derive.js's fixed rules where readBy says so; fingerprinted, readOf or defOf). verify/tables.js fails unless the ai-reading columns are exactly the fingerprinted ones and the ai-summary columns exactly gist.

RULES.what: core rules and weapon abilities: name → text (glossary)

name.note: the rule's name in the Core Rules

text.note: GW's Core Rules / Universal Rules Updates, or Wahapedia's core rules where marked; checked by verify/texts.js

RULE_SRC.what: where a RULES entry comes from when it is not a core rule

name.note: a RULES entry that is no core rule (its faction’s or a datasheet’s term: verify/texts.js checks its text against those pages)

source.note: where it comes from, by fixed templates over its place in the tables (verify/derive.js ruleSrcOf: “{ally} army rule (allies)”, “weapon ability of the {weapons} ({unit})”, “term in {ability} ({unit})”); verify/texts.js ruleSrc: stored = derived

RULE_ALIASES.what: which RULES entry a keyword or rule chip opens: [pattern, rule]

pattern.note: which chip opens which rule: mechanical where it reads the rule’s own name (verify/texts.js alias: “feel no pain”, its value aside), a player’s word for a rule otherwise, signed off (approvals.json, rule-alias); it writes no line
pattern.declared: which chip opens which rule; it writes no line: mechanical where it reads the rule’s own name (verify/texts.js alias), a player’s word for a rule otherwise (verify/helpers.js rule-alias)

rule.note: the RULES entry it opens: verify/texts.js alias fails on one that is not there

CONCEPTS.what: core terms kept out of a unit's rule list

id.note: stable id (the app links by it)
id.declared: an id: what the app links by, no line

gist.note: AI-written one-line summary of the stratagem, written from its WHEN / TARGET / EFFECT / RESTRICTIONS; signed off (approvals.json); gistOf is the fingerprint of that text

gistOf.note: fingerprint of the text the AI-written column was written from (8 hex of its sha256): verify/tables.js --stamp writes it, the gate step "fingerprints" fails when the text no longer matches

name.note: GW's document, or Wahapedia where GW has none; checked by verify/texts.js

phases.note: derived from the words by verify/derive.js (its rule tables) only: the gate fails on a stored timing label it does not derive (no hand labels); where its reading is not the signed-off label the row has none (verify/derive-unread.json, verify/out/derive.md)

turn.note: derived from the words by verify/derive.js (its rule tables) only: the gate fails on a stored timing label it does not derive (no hand labels); where its reading is not the signed-off label the row has none (verify/derive-unread.json, verify/out/derive.md)

turns.note: derived from the words by verify/derive.js (its rule tables) only: the gate fails on a stored timing label it does not derive (no hand labels); where its reading is not the signed-off label the row has none (verify/derive-unread.json, verify/out/derive.md)

needs.note: which units it is for: the needs its TARGET gives by the closed patterns of verify/derive.js stratNeeds; verify/evidence.js "targets" fails on any difference or an unparsed TARGET

note.note: GW’s words alone, each quoted under a fixed source label (“Wahapedia FAQ: “…” “…””, “FAQ (Faction Pack 1.3): …”): verify/texts.js noteForm (the form, the labels its NOTE_LABELS fix) and noteQuote (each quote word for word in the documents its label names, GW’s or Wahapedia’s); no prose of the app’s

cpNote.note: its extra-CP chip (“Or: +1CP”, “Into the Fray +1CP”): the parts of its EFFECT GW prints with an extra cost, by two closed patterns (verify/effects-extract.js cpNoteOf); verify/lines.js L0: stored = derived, and no other “+NCP” in the EFFECT

RULE_OPTIONS.what: the options inside a rule or ability, each with the phases its words give

rule.note: the rule or ability (faction · detachment · rule, or list · unit · ability)

found.note: how verify/derive.js found it (a table row, "**Name:** effect", a bullet)

explicit.note: its own words name when it is used

trigger.note: when it is used (its words, or the rule's)

GRANTS.what: a rule or option giving units an ability or keyword

option.note: the option of it that gives it

to.note: which units (needs), or this unit / model

while.note: the option active, or the words' condition

BS_IDS.what: the BSData ids the list import resolves an export by (verify/import-ids.js --write)

BOXES.what: the Damage tab's boxes of each rule, ability and stratagem of the lists (a|, r|, s|, c| + the hash of its name and text, as the app finds it): made by script from GW's words (verify/effects-migrate.js --write, verify/effects-extract.js, effects.js); the gate step evidence (verify/evidence.js) checks each against the words and that this table is exactly what they give

n.note: the source's name (its rule, ability or stratagem)

nc.note: its sentences of a rare mechanic the Damage tab does not play (effects.js NC): shown with GW's words, "not counted in the Damage tab"

reach.note: an aura's units (GW tags it Aura): the friendly units its words reach, literal keywords

both.note: another rule's two options at once for the units it reaches ("the Conqueror Imperative and Protector Imperative are both active for that unit", Icon of War): names, quote, reach, mark, opt, lasts, read by verify/effects-extract.js

embarked.note: a model of the unit not on the battlefield yet, read by one fixed pattern of GW's words ("If your Canis Rex model is destroyed, this model is treated as a model disembarking from a destroyed Transport"): until (the model it waits for)

played.note: a core rule the Damage tab plays itself (calc: [LANCE] from the weapon's keyword; situation: Plunging Fire): its boxes are the datasheet footnotes' only (verify/effects-migrate.js)

riled.note: an ability whose words say "This unit is riled up." (one fixed pattern, verify/effects-extract.js): the unit is always riled up

d.note: its defence boxes, the datasheet's "When targeted" lines (BOXES.d): read from GW's words by verify/effects-extract.js (defenceOf) with effects.js DF; held to them by verify/defence.js D1-D8; not the Damage tab's

dnc.note: its sentences about attacks against the unit that no defence reads (effects.js DNC, its why): shown as "not counted here: see the rule", never left out (verify/defence.js D4)

dreach.note: a stratagem that protects a unit other than its TARGET (its WHEN's "targets a friendly X unit", its TARGET's "within N\" of a friendly X unit that was selected as the target"): those units, literal keywords (Grot Shields, Blessing of Burning Blood)

st.note: a rule’s stat boxes: a characteristic of its units’ models its words change (“add 2 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit”), the line under a unit’s profile on its screen (verify/effects-extract.js statOf; verify/lines.js LS)

snc.note: the sentences of a source’s words that change a characteristic (M, OC, T, Sv, W, Ld) no stat box counts: { quote, stat, why, foe (an enemy’s), reach (the friendly units its words name), on (selfKw: a keyword of the unit an opening “If this model has the X keyword” needs) }, listed under a unit’s profile “not counted here: see the rule” where it reaches (verify/effects-extract.js statNc; verify/lines.js LS, LW, LF)

BOXES.b.what: one box of the Damage tab: what GW's sentence does, as the catalogue (effects.js) reads it

quote.note: the sentence of GW's text the box reads, verbatim (lines of one list joined by a line break); checked by evidence G2

lead.note: the line or sentence it continues (its condition or subject), verbatim; evidence G2

fx.note: its effects: [[effects.js FX id, value]], found in the quote by the catalogue's patterns (evidence G1, G3)

on.note: its conditions: [[effects.js COND id, value]] (q: GW's own words of a condition no catalogue entry reads; opt: the option of its rule), the box's label (evidence G5)

kind.note: ranged, melee or all: from its words (ranged attacks, the Shooting phase, …)

scope.note: the weapons and models it names: weapon (a weapon's name or the head word of it), wkw (a weapon keyword), models (model, one, char, nonchar), part (the models of an attached unit's part)

reach.note: the friendly units it reaches (an aura, a unit another unit selects, a rule's units): { all, any, none } of literal keywords (evidence G5)

mark.note: how it reaches them: aura, selected or friendly

lasts.note: how long it lasts past its step: turn, round or battle (its words: until the end of the turn, …)

opt.note: the option of its rule it is (a table's row, a named option, a bold heading)

pick.note: one of several (a table's rows its rule picks one of, "Or:" bullets, "select one of the following", "select either the X or Y ability", ", or … instead"): [{ name, fx, quote, on, part }]

part.note: a part of a pick counted only while a fact of the table holds (the Conqueror Imperative's +1 AP: BATTLELINE, or within 6" …)

limit.note: how many of its rule's boxes can be active at once, in its words ("activate up to two Blessings of Khorne")

tableRows.note: the box is its rule's table, a pick of its rows (one tick for the rule)

pool.note: a re-roll of one die: how often, read from GW's words by closed patterns (selected: each time the unit is selected to shoot or fight, one for the unit; phase, turn, round)

excl.note: one of a unit's abilities to pick from (New Recruit's "X: pick one", X the ability whose words say "select one X ability"): X; ticking one unticks the others

BOXES.d.what: one defence box: what GW's sentence does for a unit when it is attacked, as the catalogue (effects.js DF) reads it; the datasheet's "When targeted" line

quote.note: the sentence of GW's text the box reads, verbatim; verify/defence.js D2

lead.note: the line it continues (its condition), verbatim; D2

df.note: its defences: [effects.js DF id, value], found in the quote by the catalogue's patterns; D1, D3

on.note: its conditions: effects.js COND and DCOND ids (q: GW's words of one no id reads); D5

kind.note: the attacks it is against (ranged, melee, psychic, all), from its clause's words

scope.note: models: the models of the unit it is for (model: the one with the ability; a keyword: "that CHARACTER", "KASTELAN ROBOT models in that unit")

reach.note: the friendly units it is given to, literal keywords; D5

mark.note: how it reaches them: aura, selected, friendly

notSelf.note: "other friendly", "because of this … model": not the unit with it

foe.note: an enemy unit's attacks made worse, whatever they target ("each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack"): every unit of the list

opt.note: the option of its rule it is

pick.note: one of several to pick ("select one of the following"): name, df, quote

term.note: a faction's own term the ability names in bold (a RULES entry RULE_SRC says is not a core rule: Pulse Jet Move) whose words the box reads; its condition the ability's sentence naming it

until.note: how long it lasts where its words say longer than the phase ("until the start of your next Command phase"), GW's words; verify/defence.js D5

BOXES.st.what: one stat box: a characteristic of a unit’s models GW’s sentence changes, as the catalogue (effects.js ST) reads it; the line under the unit’s profile (“Not Battle-shocked: OC 7”)

quote.note: the sentence of GW’s text the box reads, verbatim; verify/lines.js LS

st.note: its effects: [effects.js ST id, value], found in the quote by the catalogue’s patterns; LS

on.note: its conditions: effects.js COND and STCOND ids (q: GW’s words of one no pattern reads), read in its sentence; LS

reach.note: the friendly units its words name (literal keywords), in its sentence or the one before it

scope.note: models: the keyword of the models it is for (“of TZAANGOR models in that unit”)
